name: reactor-mode-4h-battle-command-taken
description: #110 attempt 1: the menu closes when a command is taken. From "battle": wait until the widget id reads 1 (open_wait), then Circle every 30 frames (held 4) until it reads 0, target selection (target_wait), 20 frames with no input, then Circle every 30 frames (held 4) until it reads 0xffff, no menu (closed_wait; Attack on the default target). Checks it still reads 0xffff 10 frames later with no input (none), and battle mode. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.

widget.description: g_BattleMenuModalWidgetId (s16 as u16; config/symbols.battle.txt 0x800F3896; src/battle/battle3.c): the battle menu widget taking input. -1 (0xffff) none (BattleMenuInit), 1 the command menu (Cancel from a sub-menu returns to 1), 0 target selection (BattleMenuUpdate runs the targeting code when it reads 0), 3/7/0x18/0x1A/0x1B sub-menus.
